The after image adds one useful positive-oblique line near the right side and converts the corresponding prompt from negative-slope fallback to midpoint, but oblique detections remain sparse and short across most vertical bands.
proposal.rule: Continue the accepted stage-4 missing-line remediation by improving continuity of fragmented oblique evidence while preserving the accepted oblique accumulator threshold and the correct 10-ring result.
proposal.rationale: Increasing maxLineGap_oblique should allow nearby collinear joint fragments to form longer oblique detections, potentially replacing additional fallback prompts and improving correspondence. The proposed value 74 is within the allowed [30, 80] range and appears in the successful complex-family development overlay, but that example is treated only as a joint-outcome analogy rather than per-parameter causal proof. No unfolding parameter is changed because stage 1 is locked.
